description: Self-hosted multi-tenant MCP server for the Meta Marketing API: 142 ads_* and whatsapp_* tools, OAuth 2.1, Ad Library research, video keyframes, Gemini analysis, ad dossier, skills.
rules: Tools are named ads_* or whatsapp_*; no meta_ prefix since v3.0.0, and ad_set is spelled with an underscore.
A tool whose description starts with a warning sign changes live ads, spends money or touches stored credentials; confirm with the user before calling it.
Video: ads_get_video_media delivery=frames for image-capable models; delivery=inline (20 MiB per video over HTTP, 6 MiB per result over stdio) only for video-capable ones.
Over stdio a result carries at most 6 MiB of media in total, images and poster included; prefer frames there.
ads_analyze_video uses the tenant's own Gemini key and costs about 0.02 USD per call; a repeat may hit a short-lived per-instance cache, which is not guaranteed.
ads_library_* scrape the Ad Library through the tenant's Apify account, about 0.75 USD per 1,000 ads. Re-reading a dataset is free; a repeated scrape runs and bills again.
Ad account ids take the act_ prefix and other Meta ids are numeric strings; Apify run and dataset ids are alphanumeric. Self-hosting needs Node.js 22.13+; ffmpeg is optional, the image has it.
